verdict.rationale: Zep exposes API/SDK operations for adding messages/data (thread.add_messages, graph ingestion), searching (semantic+BM25 graph search, scope=auto context retrieval), updating (custom entity/edge types, incremental thread summaries), and deleting (edge/node/user deletion) that an agent can invoke itself via tool calls or direct API, and also offers a Memory MCP Server so agents can call these as standardized tools mid-conversation. missing for 10: no independent hands-on evidence of an agent autonomously orchestrating these calls mid-conversation (only vendor docs), and no explicit example of an agent-initiated update flow distinct from ingestion.
